segments.title: Cold Open: Pepito Sign-On and Apartment Prank

segments.title: Rennerton Mayoral Rap Battle: Crum Endorses Hamtaro, Munch Endorses Pepito

segments.title: Rennerton Town Hall: Pepito, September, Hype Train, Kendall, Shamrock Johnson Take Questions

segments.title: Sign-Off and Raid to 'No Pro'
segments.notes: Case wraps three-hour broadcast, confirms Saturday noon Rennerton election stream, and raids a channel called 'no pro.'

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covered Hurricane Milton fallout and Biden's 'get a life' rebuke to Trump before a science desk deep-dive into alt-right interracial porn consumption statistics and colonial racist tropes. The broadcast featured trailer reviews for Nautilus, Yakuza, Paddington in Peru, and a 2x-speed Baddies Caribbean Reunion, a Joe Rogan parody centered on stool intimacy and Jamie's brisket pot, and a viral video roundup. The evening culminated in a Rennerton mayoral rap battle (Munch/Pepito vs. Crum/Hamtaro) and a five-candidate Town Hall featuring gun farms, universal harems, bat-wing condiment preferences, Pop-Tart ontology, and a near-living Shamrock Shake river monster ahead of Saturday's election stream.
